object.title: 文明图谱阈值
object.canonicalQuestion: 为什么知道文明是什么以后，还必须知道它位于怎样的运行位置

articles.title: 什么时候我们真正面对的是文明运行，而不仅是文明名称
articles.summary: 文明运行不是城市、国家、文字、技术或人口的对象清单，而是制度、记忆、知识、意义、基础设施、人口与载体彼此进入对方时间以后形成的跨世代关系状态。真正重要的是这些层是否仍能互相转换、再生产和迁移；库存很多却转换失效，文明仍会下降。文明图谱阈值由此出现：知道某个社会“是文明”仍不足以判断它正在扩展、维护、失配、迁移、收缩还是继任，必须把能力、负荷、方向、时间距离与未来余量放进多维运行位置，而不是压成单一排名。

articles.title: When We Are Truly Looking at Civilizational Runtime Rather Than a Civilization Label
articles.summary: Civilizational runtime is not an inventory of cities, states, writing, technology, or population. It is an intergenerational relationship state formed when institutions, memory, knowledge, meaning, infrastructure, population, and carriers enter one another’s time. What matters is whether these layers can still convert into one another, reproduce capacity, and migrate; a civilization with vast stocks can still decline when conversion fails. This is where the threshold of a Civilization Atlas appears: knowing that a society is a civilization is not enough to tell whether it is expanding, maintaining, mismatching, migrating, contracting, or entering succession. Capacity, load, direction, temporal distance, and future headroom must be located in a multidimensional runtime position rather than compressed into a single ranking.
